statistics.equal_scenario: Average scenario pooled scores with equal fixed scenario weights; resample utterance clusters within scenario.
statistics.natural: Resample whole utterances, retaining all dependent recordings together.
statistics.posthoc_subgroups: Descriptive; no admission based on a discovered subgroup.
